status: best estimates pending bench identification; nothing here is measured on an APE0 part
scope: Joint-side actuator dynamics layered on the unchanged R3 rigid MJCF, URDF, masses, sensors and timing. 'nominal' is the best estimate used by default; 'low' and 'high' bound it for sensitivity, not for randomization.

law.feetech_duty: Firmware position loop (BAM STS3215 model): the internal target moves toward the commanded target at most target_rate_limit_rad_s; duty = clamp(duty_gain_per_rad * (internal target - q, less half the backlash), +-max_duty); output torque = stall_torque_Nm * (duty - qd / no_load_speed_rad_s), limited to +-stall_torque_Nm (current limit). This keeps the catalog torque-speed line at full duty and adds the back-EMF damping stall/no-load speed inside it.
law.joint: armature_kg_m2 and frictionloss_Nm are MuJoCo joint attributes (reflected rotor inertia and Coulomb friction at the output). No extra viscous damping: the catalog no-load speed already contains it.
law.rated_torque: Continuous (thermal) reference only. The physical limit is the full curve; RMS current over rated current is reported as the heat proxy.

duty_gain_per_rad.source: BAM STS3215 firmware model: kp 32 x error_gain 0.166 x fitted ratio 1.00-1.16 (m1 1.005, m6 1.162); the C047 runs the same Feetech STS firmware (assumed)

target_rate_limit_rad_s.source: BAM STS3215 fitted max_velocity 5.29 (m1) / 5.10 (m6) at 7.4 V, about 1.1x its no-load speed; applied as 1.1x the C047 no-load speed (assumption)

frictionloss_Nm.source: BAM STS3215 friction_base 0.0515 (m1), 0.0533 (m6); load-dependent friction (m6) not modelled

backlash_rad.source: half the 0.5 deg catalog upper bound in actuators.json (assumption)

ak45-10.catalog_source: cubemars.com/de/product/ak45-10-v3-0-kv75-robotic-actuator.html (read 2026-11-06): 24 V, 2.5 N m rated at 120 rpm, 7 N m peak, 180 rpm no-load, 1.9 A rated, 5 A peak, 0.127 N m/A motor Kt, 10:1, 157.33 g cm2 rotor, 262 g, phi53 x 45.2 mm, 39 W max continuous, 18 arcmin. Law: the line from 7 N m at standstill to 180 rpm passes the 2.5 N m / 120 rpm rated point (2.33 N m), so peak torque is used as the stall intercept. Rail: the runtime scales every law by rail/12 (11.1/12 for the 3S pack); a 6S pack (22.2 V) on a 24 V rating gives the same 0.925, so the 24 V catalog enters unchanged and the knees need their own 6S supply. Currents are at 22-24 V, not comparable in amps with the 11.1 V servos. No-load current is not published; 0.1 A is an assumption.

unchanged_from_r3: 20 ms command and 10 ms feedback delay, 50 Hz control, 0.25 ms physics

rail_V.source: 3S3P pack in the internal power packaging study (cove50-internal-power-space-r7): 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full, about 10.5 V low or sagging under load; body servos assumed on the pack rail (catalog figures are at 12 V and scale with rail voltage). The XM335 neck keeps R3's regulated rail capped at 12 V.

supply.note: Jobs bundled before 2026-11-05 10:15 UTC (r4-{c047,sts3250,st3025}-20261105) ran at 12 V.

joint_ranges_deg.note: Best-estimate ranges for joints whose R3 source range is unspecified, per side (R_ and L_). R3 sign convention: hip pitch - flexes.
joint_ranges_deg.source: Assumption. The selected hip (hip-direct-serial-low-roll r3) specifies no range, and R3 exported the six hip axes unlimited with a +-0.35 rad diagnostic command envelope that is not a joint limit. Nominal values follow primate/human hip range of motion (flexion about 120 deg, extension 20-30 deg, abduction about 45 deg, adduction 20-30 deg, rotation 35-45 deg) narrowed for a compact servo hip, and cover the agility motion set (hip pitch -82..+12 deg, roll +-22 deg, yaw -20..+16 deg) with margin; low is the narrowest range that still covers the motion set. Moving-part clearance in CAD and the actual mechanical stops are unqualified (a CAD sweep or bench check).

revisions.note: Actuator dynamics (rotor inertia, friction, Feetech duty loop, rate limit, backlash, catalog law) at a 12 V rail; jobs r4-{c047,sts3250,st3025}-20261105.
Adds supply.rail_V (11.1 V 3S3P pack); jobs tape-*-20261105.
Adds best-estimate hip ranges (joint_ranges_deg) in place of the +-0.35 rad diagnostic hip command envelope; first used by tape2-*-20261105.
Adds two 24 V brushless knee candidates (ak45-10, ak60-6) from CubeMars catalog pages for the stronger-knee mixed sets; earlier models unchanged.
Adds two 12 V knee candidates on the existing rail (st3215-hs: faster, weaker; rsbl85-12: stronger, slower).
Adds st3025-x1.5: the ST3025 knee through an assumed 1:1.5 speed-up stage, a same-rail design option.
Corrects the st3025-x1.5 duty gain per knee radian (6.43/1.5 = 4.287, was 9.645 in 3.2, inverted); knee-geared-stance-20261106 ran with the 3.2 value.
Adds four 24 V brushless joint motors (edulite-05, gim3505-8, dm-j3507, dm-j4310) from the category-round catalogue for whole-body 24 V plant variants.
